title: Assessing Large Language Models’ ability to predict how humans balance self-interest and the interest of others

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting generative AI chatbots (GPT-4, Bard, Bing) with experimental instructions from 108 dictator game experiments and comparing the models' predicted distributions of human monetary allocations against actual empirical data to measure the overestimation of prosocial/altruistic behavior and the underestimation of self-interest.
